parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with mechanism action_type INHIBITOR. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_mechanism on molregno, and target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter where max_phase equals 4 and action_type equals INHIBITOR. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (as target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (as target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
